question: The average time taken by 7 athletes in a race is 2 minutes 10 seconds. If the winner completed the race in 1 minute 40 seconds, then the average time taken by the other athletes is:
solution:
**Given**

Average time = 2 minutes 10 second

number of athletes = 7

**Formula used**

Average = Sum of all observation/Number of observation

1 minute = 60 seconds

**Calculation**

Total time taken by 7 athletes = 7 × (2 minutes and 10 seconds)

⇒ 7 × 130 seconds

⇒ 910 seconds

⇒ 15 minutes 10 seconds

Average time taken by other athletes = (15 minutes 10 seconds - 1 minute 40 seconds)/6

⇒ (13 minutes 30 seconds)/6

⇒ 2 minutes 15 seconds 

since (13 minutes = 12 minutes + 1 minute)

⇒ 12 minutes are divided by 6 = 2 minutes

⇒ 1minutes = 60 seconds

⇒ total 60 + 30 seconds

⇒ 90 seconds 

when 90 is divided by 6 = 15 

so, average time is 2 minutes 15 seconds

**∴ Average time is 2 minutes 15 seconds**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** Given:-

Average time of all 7 players (***a***) = 2 min 10 sec = 130 sec

Average time of n players (***b***) = 1 min 40 sec = 100 sec

where, n = 1

Average of remaining players(***c***) = ?

**Formula used :-**

Number of remaining player = large{(n(a -b))/((c -a))} 

**Calculation:-**

According to question-

⇒ 6 = [1 × (130 - 100)]/(c - 130)

⇒ 6c - 780 = 30

⇒ 6c = 810

⇒ c = 135 = 2 min 15 sec

∴ **Average time of remaining players is 2 min 15 se****c.**
